info.title: MolBhav API
info.description: Market & Procurement Intelligence — मोल समझो, भाव परखो, बेहतर खरीदो।

get.summary: Full category tree including inactive items and all translations.

409.description: Code already used in this category (`SubCategory.CodeTaken`).

get.summary: Product list including inactive products; `name` is the English name.

400.description: Invalid input, or unknown sub-category / unit (`SubCategory.NotFound`, `UnitOfMeasure.NotFound`).

409.description: Code already used for this product (`ProductVariant.CodeTaken`).

get.summary: All keys, optionally restricted to one namespace (e.g. `alerts.`), with every translation.
Full state tree including inactive states/districts.

409.description: District name already used in this state (`District.NameTaken`).

400.description: Invalid input, or an unknown product/variant/unit/mandi/supplier/source reference.

409.description: A record already exists for this product/location/source/date (`PriceRecord.Duplicate`).

post.summary: Sends a 6-digit login code to the mobile number. Creates no account.

422.description: A code was sent less than a minute ago (`Otp.ResendTooSoon`).

post.summary: Verifies the code. The first successful verification for a number registers the account.

200.description: Logged in. `isOnboarded = false` → show the onboarding screen next.

400.description: Wrong code (`Otp.Incorrect`), no code requested (`Otp.ChallengeNotFound`) or invalid input.

422.description: Code expired, already used, or too many wrong attempts — request a new code.

post.summary: Exchanges a refresh token for a new session. The presented refresh token is consumed (single use).

401.description: Refresh token invalid, expired or revoked — clear tokens and return to login.

200.description: New access + refresh token — replace both in secure storage.

409.description: Token was just rotated by a parallel refresh (`RefreshToken.Superseded`) — retry with the stored token.

post.summary: Revokes this device's refresh token. Idempotent. The (short-lived) access token simply expires.

get.summary: Select Category screen: categories with their sub-categories.
Products in a category, optionally one sub-category and/or a name search (matches any language).
Product header for the comparison / trends / opportunity screens: names, default unit, variants.
Units with conversion factors to their dimension's base unit (quantity pickers, client-side conversion).
Every key (or one namespace, e.g. `?keyPrefix=alerts.`) resolved to text in the request's language, falling back to English.
Agriculture pricing locations (BRD §11), optionally narrowed to a district and/or a name search.
Construction regional suppliers/hubs (BRD §12), optionally narrowed to a district and/or a name search.
Comparison matrix: latest non-voided price per mandi/supplier for a product.
Trend sparkline: non-voided prices for a product at one location over a date range.

post.summary: Refreshes the requirement's opportunity list against current prices (a new snapshot batch each call).

get.summary: The signed-in user's profile. Phone number is returned masked.

put.summary:
Completes onboarding / saves the edit-profile screen. Full replacement of profile fields and categories.
A changed preferred language takes effect in the access token on the next refresh.

get.summary: Connectivity and language-negotiation check for the mobile app.

404.description: Unknown product, or the variant does not belong to it (`Product.NotFound`, `ProductVariant.NotFound`).

variantId.description: Optional: watch a specific variant instead of the whole product.

AdminProductSummaryResponse.description: Admin product list row; string AdminProductSummaryResponse.Name is the English name.

AlertResponse.description: One triggered alert instance, newest first.

AlertRuleResponse.description: A standing watch on a product's price. LocationKind? AlertRuleResponse.LocationKind null means product-wide.

AlertThresholdType.description: Direction of the price move an AlertRule watches for (BRD §15).

ApiResponseOfAdminIngestionJobResponse.description:
Success envelope for every 2xx body. Errors are never wrapped: they are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json`
(with `errorCode` and `traceId` extensions), so clients branch on HTTP status, not on a flag.

CategoryResponse.description: Select Category screen: a category with its active sub-categories.

CostComponentType.description:
How a CostComponent's `Value` is applied on top of the base price × quantity (BRD §17/§25 —
            freight/handling/tax/supplier-terms are explicitly future-facing "landed cost" inputs; this is the extensible slot for them).

CreatedResponse.description: Returned by every admin create command.

oneOf.description: Mass, Volume, Count, Length or Area. Immutable after creation.

toBaseFactor.description: Base units per one of this unit: kg (mass), m³ (volume), piece (count), m (length), m² (area). Immutable after creation.

IngestionTriggerType.description: What started a DataIngestionJob (BRD §9/§18 — background workers, plus an admin-triggered path).

LatestPriceResponse.description: One location's latest price for a product — a row in the comparison matrix (BRD §10/§11/§12).

LocalizedTextTranslationInput.description: One language's text as submitted by the admin portal.

LocationKind.description: Which market-module aggregate a PriceRecord's location points to. Exactly one of Mandi/Supplier id is set to match.

isNewUser.description: Account was created by this login.

isOnboarded.description: False → show onboarding (category + profile) before home.

LoginResponse.description: Login result: the session plus routing hints for the first screen after login.

MandiResponse.description: Agriculture pricing location (BRD §11), for the mandi/location pickers on comparison and watchlist screens.

MeasureDimension.description:
What a unit measures. Conversions are only defined within one dimension; each has one base unit that
decimal UnitOfMeasure.ToBaseFactor is expressed in.

NotificationChannel.description: Delivery channel for a NotificationMessage (BRD §14/§25 — WhatsApp/push alerts).

OtpSentResponse.description: Returned by "send code". The app shows a countdown of int OtpSentResponse.ResendCooldownSeconds before enabling "resend".

ProductSummaryResponse.description: Product list row (category/product pickers, watchlist "add item").

productId.description: The product this price is for.

unitId.description: Unit the prices are quoted in.

oneOf.description: Whether this is a mandi (agriculture) or supplier (construction) price.

recordDate.description: The date this price was observed.

ReportType.description:
What a Report summarizes. Kept as a closed set for MVP — the generator maps each value
            to its own query/template; a genuinely ad-hoc/custom report is future scope.

phoneNumber.description: 10-digit Indian mobile; +91/0 prefixes, spaces and dashes are accepted.

TranslationInput.description: One language's text as submitted by the admin portal.

UpdateAlertRuleRequest.description: Both fields are required — there is no partial update, so a missing one can't silently deactivate a rule.

UpdateCostComponentRequest.description: Both fields are required — there is no partial update, so a missing one can't silently deactivate a component.

UpdatePlanRequest.description: Both fields are required — there is no partial update, so a missing one can't silently deactivate a plan.

preferredLanguage.description: ISO-639-1: en, hi, mr, gu, ta, te, kn.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Onboarding / edit-profile screen. Full replacement: omitted optional fields are cleared, categories are replaced.

phoneNumber.description: The same number the code was sent to.

WatchlistItemResponse.description: One watched product (or variant), localized the same way as the catalog product list, with latest price enrichment for the home/watchlist screens.

Bearer.description: Access token from the OTP login flow.
